# get_outings

**v1.4.0 or later**: this tool is not in v1.3.0. On v1.3.0, call [`get_outing`](get_outing.md) once per outing.

## Purpose

Read up to 10 outings (trip reports) in one call, each printed as [`get_outing`](get_outing.md) prints it. Use it to read the reports a search found, such as the recent outings of a route, without one call per report. Each text section is cut at 2,000 characters, and a cut section says how to read more with `get_outing`. Outings are past reports, not a forecast.

## Inputs

<!-- generated:inputs start -->

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:tools from the registered input schema. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Type             | Required | Default | Constraints                                 |
| --------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `ids`     | array of integer | yes      |         | at least 1 item, at most 10 items, each > 0 |
| `lang`    | string           | no       |         |                                             |

- `ids`: Up to 10 outing IDs from Camptocamp (e.g. \[1924138, 1917601\]), printed in this order; a repeated ID is read once.
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`

<!-- generated:inputs end -->

## Output format

One block per ID, in the order of `ids`, separated by one blank line. An outing that was read prints the [`get_outing` output](get_outing.md#output-format); an ID that could not be read prints two lines:

```text
# <title> (ID: <id>)
**URL**: https://www.camptocamp.org/outings/<id>
…
## <section>
[begin user-written text: <field>]
<at most 2,000 characters of text>
[truncated, N more characters; get_outing {id: <id>} shows up to 8,000]
[end user-written text: <field>]
…

# Outing not read (ID: <id>)
Error: <message>
```

- **Each outing block** is exactly what `get_outing` prints for the same ID and `lang`, the cut aside: the same facts, the `**Partial trip**: yes` line, every text section (there is no input to choose them) and the associated routes.
- **A text section over 2,000 characters** is cut, and its last line before the end marker is `[truncated, N more characters; get_outing {id: <id>} shows up to 8,000]`. N is counted as `get_outing` counts it: in characters, after the image tags, links and headings are rewritten. `get_outing` with that ID prints up to 8,000 characters of each section.
- **An ID that could not be read** prints `# Outing not read (ID: <id>)` then `Error: <message>`, where the message is the one `get_outing` gives for that ID. The other outings are still printed, and the call does not fail.
- **A repeated ID** is read and printed once, where it first appears.
- **Requests** go out in parallel, at most 3 at a time, with the same User-Agent, 15 s timeout and 10 MiB cap as `get_outing`.

## Example

An Innominata report from the [`search_outings` example](search_outings.md#example) and an unknown ID, `get_outings {ids: [1924138, 999999999]}`, captured from v1.4.0 on 2026-10-05. The report text has zero-width spaces at the start of some lines, kept as captured; the spaces at the end of two lines were removed by this repository's formatter:

```text
**Activities**: mountain_climbing
**Date**: 2026-07-03 → 2026-07-05

**Global rating**: D+
**Engagement**: IV
**Conditions**: average
**Max elevation**: 4810m
**Min elevation**: 1590m
**Elevation gain**: 3220m
**Elevation loss**: 3445m

​
Conditions détaillées par secteur
​1. Approche & Bivouac Eccles
​Glacier du Brouillard : Très ouvert. On trouve cependant des traces récentes qui semblent remonter vers le col. Attention, présence d'un peu de glace vive juste sous le refuge. Nous avons le choix de passer par l’arête de l’inominata plutôt que le glacier l’arête est seche et sans neige mais permet d'accéder au col. Le rocher est plutôt instable.

​Rimaye d'accès : Le passage de la rimaye est OK, la traversée s'est faite sans problème. Peu de chutes de pierres constatées dans le secteur.
​Vie au bivouac : Pas ou très peu d'eau de fonte disponible. Il y a un peu de neige à proximité pour faire de l'eau au réchaud.

​Pointe Eccles : Escalade complètement sèche. Le rocher est assez instable sur le début de l'ascension. Pas de neige jusqu'au Col Eccles. La descente sur le col est aisée.
​Du Col Eccles à la Tour Rouge : Le rocher se remonte facilement. Il est sec et globalement bon dans cette section. Les fissures sont totalement sèches.

​Le Grand Couloir : Très sec. Le rocher y est particulièrement instable, mais nous n'avons pas subi de chutes de pierres lors de notre passage car passage avant lever du jour.

## Associated routes
- [54513] Mont Blanc : Arête de l'Innominata | Global rating: D+ | Engagement: IV | Rock free rating: 5b | Rock required rating: 4b | Ice rating: 2 | Mixed rating: M2
- [54684] Punta Innominata : Arête SE | Global rating: AD | Engagement: III | Equipment: P4 | Rock free rating: 4a | Rock required rating: 4a

# Outing not read (ID: 999999999)
Error: Camptocamp API error: 404 Not Found (outing 999999999): document not found
```

- The route description, 1,938 characters, is under 2,000 and printed whole. The outing has no `## Conditions` section: its author wrote none.
- Captured the same way, `get_outings {ids: [1917601, 1545314]}` cuts two sections: the description of 1917601 ends with `[truncated, 251 more characters; get_outing {id: 1917601} shows up to 8,000]`, and the 3,272-character conditions of 1545314 with `[truncated, 1272 more characters; get_outing {id: 1545314} shows up to 8,000]`.

## Limits

- **At most 10 IDs per call.** An empty list or more than 10 IDs is refused before any request. `get_outings {ids: []}`, captured from v1.4.0 on 2026-10-05:

  ```text
  MCP error -32602: Input validation error: Invalid arguments for tool get_outings: must list at least 1 ID at ids
  ```

- **Sections are cut at 2,000 characters**, against 8,000 in `get_outing`. Call `get_outing` with the ID named in the `[truncated, …]` line to read more, or the camptocamp.org page of the `**URL**` line for the whole text.
- **Ten long reports can exceed Claude Code's 25,000-token output cap.** Each outing prints up to six sections of 2,000 characters, so ten outings can carry 120,000 characters of text. Measured on v1.4.0 on 2026-10-05, the 10 most recent Innominata outings (`search_outings {route_id: 54513}`) print 28,870 characters, with 4 sections cut. Above the cap, or above 50,000 characters, Claude Code saves the result to a file; ask for fewer IDs per call, or see [Tool output](../clients/claude-code.md#tool-output-warning-at-10000-tokens-cap-at-25000) in the Claude Code page.
- **A Camptocamp outage can outlast the client's timeout.** Each request gives up after 15 s, and 10 IDs go out in 4 rounds of 3, so if Camptocamp stops responding the call takes 60 s before its `# Outing not read` blocks arrive. That equals the MCP TypeScript SDK's default client timeout of 60 s, so a client may give up first and show a timeout instead.
- **An unknown ID is not an error of the call.** It gets its own `# Outing not read` block; check each block before quoting it.
- **The limits of `get_outing` apply**: no author, routes only, a missing line means Camptocamp has no value, no line says the route was completed, and ratings and conditions are those of one day, as the author reported them. See [`get_outing` Limits](get_outing.md#limits).
